Subject: PO metadata & invoice cadence for enterprise pricing buckets

Hi Marcus,

Thanks for the demo last week — Acme is excited about Redwood for inference across our clinical analytics workloads. Procurement has a couple of constraints we need to resolve before we can raise a PO and get legal to finish the SOW amendment:

- We price discounts by "committed spend buckets" and our ERP requires a PO line item per pricing bucket (so multiple PO lines under a single PO). Will Redwood accept multiple line items referencing the same Master Agreement?
- Required metadata on our POs: PO number, cost center code, GL account, contract ref (Master Agreement ID), billing contact, remit-to address, and an invoice frequency flag (monthly vs quarterly consolidated).
- Preferred payment terms are Net 30 for most vendors. For platform vendors we sometimes request Net 45/Net 60 depending on our internal approval cycles. What terms can Redwood accept for an enterprise discount?
- We prefer a single monthly consolidated invoice that aggregates multiple PO lines and includes a per-line breakdown. Can you confirm Redwood can produce that format?

Attached is our internal procurement requirements doc for reference. If you can send a PO template with the exact metadata fields Redwood needs, we can check with Finance to see if we can align cadence. Would prefer to get this resolved this week so our legal team can finish up the amendment.

Thanks,
Olivia Park
Sr. Procurement Manager
Acme Health Systems

Hi Olivia — great to hear and thanks for the clear list. Below are the practical items and next steps from Redwood's side: 

1) PO & line item handling
- Yes: we can accept a single PO with multiple line items. Each line should reference the Master Agreement ID (please include: MA-REDWOOD-<org-id> or the SOW number).
- For reconciliation we require each line to include: PO number, line description, quantity (units = compute-hours or committed token-lane), unit price, and the extended line amount.

2) Required PO metadata (fields we read/import automatically)
- PO Number
- Cost Center
- GL Account
- Contract Reference (SOW or MA ID)
- Billing Contact (name + email)
- Remit To (address & wire instructions)
- Invoice Frequency flag (monthly / quarterly)

3) Invoice cadence and format
- We can produce a consolidated monthly invoice that lists line items, per-line usage/charges, and a summary total. We can also provide CSV export for ERP ingest on request.

4) Payment terms and discounts
- Standard term: Net 30. For enterprise committed programs we will accept Net 45 with approval from Revenue Ops. Net 60 is escalated and requires finance executive sign-off plus an initial commitment milestone (usually prepay or a 3-month rolling commit).
- Discount bucketization: our systems require the PO line to map to the pricing bucket (e.g., "Committed Tier A - 15% discount"). That mapping must be visible in the PO line description or an attached mapping sheet.

I've attached our PO template and a sample invoice layout to make this plug-and-play for your ERP. If you can return a redlined PO (or the final PO) that includes the fields above and references DEAL-8421, we can provision the discount tier and update billing.

Next steps:
- Olivia: confirm which invoice cadence you prefer (monthly consolidated vs quarterly).
- If Net 45 is required, we'll route to Revenue Ops (cc Naomi).
- Send signed PO referencing MA-REDWOOD-2176 / DEAL-8421.

DocuSign link for the SOW amendment: https://docusign.com/room/ABC123-amendment

Regards,
Marcus Lin

Marcus — quick internal note. Per Revenue Ops: Net 45 is acceptable only if the discount requested is <= 15% OR the customer commits to an annual billing cadence (prepay) or a 12-month firm commit. Anything above 15% needs Ben's approval and legal to add an invoice security clause. Also: make sure the PO explicitly maps the "pricing bucket" slug to the line item so our billing automation picks it up; otherwise we'll need manual reconciliation which delays discounts.

If Acme insists on Net 60, escalate to Finance (I will not approve automatically).

-Naomi

Redwood Inference

Thanks Naomi — for this deal (Acme, large strategic regional health system) I can authorize up to 15% discount under standard Net 30 terms. I'm willing to accept 15% with Net 45 if Acme agrees to either:

- Monthly consolidated invoicing + PO mapping across buckets (so we have clean ERP ingestion), OR
- Annual invoicing (one invoice per year) with a minimum 12-month commitment.

If they want Net 60 or a deeper discount (>15%), ask Legal and Finance to prepare a collateral/security clause and escalate to Sales Leadership.

Ben Carter
